preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 5000.
The length of the string n must be between 1 and 5000 for each test case.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have length n and consist only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output must consist of the lexicographically smallest string s' followed by the smallest k that achieves it.

postconditions.expression: s_prime == min(s[i:i+k-1][::-1] + s[i+k-1:] for k in range(1, n+1) for i in range(n-k+1))
postconditions.description: The string s' must be the lexicographically smallest string achievable after the modification.

postconditions.expression: k == min(k for k in range(1, n+1) if s_prime == s[i:i+k-1][::-1] + s[i+k-1:])
postconditions.description: The value of k must be the smallest integer that produces the lexicographically smallest string s'.
